name: Dev environments
author: olafkfreund
description: devenv for Omarchy, on the bar and on a key: every devenv environment under your project roots, enter one in a terminal, edit it, start and stop its processes, update its lock, allow or revoke it, remove it in steps from revoke to delete, and create a new project from templates for languages, mobile and cloud. Create and update stream their log into the panel.

barWidget.description: Your devenv environments, allowed ones first. Driven from the keyboard: enter opens devenv shell in a terminal, e edits devenv.nix, s starts or stops processes, p checks them, g updates the lock, a allows or revokes, x removes, c creates from a template, G runs devenv gc, y copies the path, / filters, u refreshes, o shows the log, and ? lists the lot inside the panel.

schema.label: Project roots
schema.description: Folders searched for devenv.nix, separated by ':' like PATH, three levels deep, without following symlinks. Projects you allowed elsewhere are listed too. New projects go in the first one by default.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar re-reads the project roots. The panel refreshes every 5 seconds while it is open, regardless of this.

schema.label: Editor
schema.description: The command e opens devenv.nix with, in a terminal. Empty uses $EDITOR, then nvim. Plain words only, for example: hx, or nvim -p.

schema.label: Hide the bar icon when there are no environments
schema.description: On removes the button from the bar until there is an environment to show.
